name: browser-use
headline: ZMCPTools: MCP Server for Claude Code Automation
short_description: ZMCPTools is a TypeScript MCP server for Claude Code that provides web scraping, knowledge graph memory, and multi-agent coordination tools via the Model Context Protocol.
author: ZachHandley

sections.overview:
ZMCPTools is a custom TypeScript MCP (Model Context Protocol) server designed to extend Claude Code with additional automation capabilities. It includes tools for navigating and scraping web pages, storing and querying a persistent knowledge graph, and coordinating multi-agent workflows. The server indexes scraped content into a database for later retrieval, managing token limits by truncating MCP responses while preserving full storage. It is built for developers who want to augment Claude Code with durable memory, structured web data extraction, and agent-to-agent communication within a single MCP integration.
Scraping and indexing web pages for later DOM navigation and content retrieval
Storing and querying a persistent knowledge graph to give Claude Code long-term memory
Coordinating multiple AI agents in a shared workflow using multi-agent tools
Retrieving structured web content without hitting MCP token limits via smart truncation
GreenTech Solutions, a renewable energy company, aims to automate its data processing workflows using a custom TypeScript MCP Server built with ZMCPTools. This server will handle real-time energy consumption data and integrate with existing IoT devices and analytics tools.
